title: A Core\Task::all field whose function takes a parameter compiles, and the call stops with an internal error.
text: `Core\Task::all({a: fn(int $x): int => $x})` passes `nvs check`, and the run ends with `FATAL: internal error: a `callable` declaring 1 parameters was called with only 0 available`. A parameter with a default (`fn(int $x = 4)`) fails the same way. The `ShapeOfCallables` arm of the assignability check accepts any `CallableSig` field without looking at its parameters, while the runtime calls each field with none. It closes when a field function with a parameter is a diagnostic at the field, or one whose parameters all have defaults runs with them, with a conformance case.
